## Research status

**Technical owners.** 4 canonical routes.

**Owner routes.** [Routing Heads and Specialist Cores](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/routing-heads-and-specialist-cores.html), [Replaceable Cognitive Substrates: Beyond Transformer Monoculture](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/replaceable-cognitive-substrates-beyond-transformer-monoculture.html), [Coil Attention, Cyclic Memory, and Recurrence Contracts](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/coil-attention-cyclic-memory-and-recurrence-contracts.html), [CoilRA, MultiCoil RoPE, and Cyclic Mixers](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/coilra-multicoil-rope-and-cyclic-mixers.html).

**Core support states.** argument.

**Implemented bounded proof targets.** 11.

**Current boundary.** Editorial synthesis does not transfer support among owners and does not establish system-level efficiency, safety, deployment readiness, AGI, or ASI.

**What would change the conclusion.** Matched natural tasks showing no accepted-useful-output advantage after routing, migration, verification, and maintenance costs would favor a simpler substrate strategy.

**Technical evidence.** Follow the owner routes above and the live book's claim/evidence registry.
